ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Section T: Drugs, Sex, 'n' Rock and Roll: Countercultures in the Movies, 1930s - 1960s This course will study cinematic representations of alternative ideologies and behaviors, emphasizing practices that were suppressed by established authorities in the United States and Europe from the 1930s through the 1960s. While the organization of the course is chronological, it is not genetic; that is, there is no assertion of causal relationships among these periods. Postcards from the edge, if you will. In reading these postcards, we will also explore why and how these stories of ?outsiders? became integrated into the mainstream of commercial cinema. Evaluated work will include short response papers and 3?4 medium-length essays.
